task: First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task is a listed sequence — 'First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box' — but the candidate contains only Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). It omits the required end of the sequence: nothing makes the target box be picked up, so FINAL_STATES is empty and the task's goal (target_picked_up) is never required. It also omits the stated orders 'open the door with it' (Precedence(has_door_key, door_open)) and picking up the box after opening the door (Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up)). Add the hard Precedence chain Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) plus a hard Existence(target_picked_up); with the chain in place the hard Existence of the last step forces blocker_moved, has_door_key and door_open, so no Existence clauses are needed for those earlier steps.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) with the hard Precedence chain blocker_moved -> has_door_key -> door_open -> target_picked_up captures the listed sequence 'move the ball, take the key, open the door, pick up the box'; the chain plus the final goal forces every earlier step, so no extra Existence clauses are needed.
